title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, requesting authority from the Department of Public Utilities, pursuant to M.G.L. c. 164, § 75C, for the right to exercise the power of eminent domain under M.G.L. c. 79 for the right to take by eminent domain such rights-of-way, permanent easements, temporary easements, or such other interests to land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration, or removal of natural gas transmission pipeline, appliances, appurtenances, and other equipment situated in the Towns of Sutton, Uxbridge, Northbridge, and Douglas in the County of Worcester.
